errors.evidence: The description omits the tick interval of the y-axis, which is 0.1, as seen by the tick marks at 0, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3, and 0.4. The prompt requires describing the 'Tick-Beschriftungsintervall, wenn numerisch und regelmäßig verteilt'.
The description omits the introductory label for the x-axis categories, which is 'Zufriedenheit mit dem/der ...'. It only lists the four categories themselves.

errors.text_span: da die Farbe und die Beschriftungen direkt die jeweiligen Werte repräsentieren
errors.evidence: This statement incorrectly claims that the color represents the values. In the chart, all bars have the same blue color, which serves to group them as a single data series. The values are represented by the height of the bars and the data labels above them, not by the color.
